fields.description: Off = whatever Website Settings and Navbar Settings already hold. On = the values below are pushed into them on save and on every migrate.
fields.label: Apply Branding

fields.options:
These write straight into Website Settings and Navbar Settings — the fields Frappe itself reads. Nothing here overrides a template.
A field left blank is never pushed, so it will not wipe a value someone set by hand upstream. Clear a value at its source instead.

fields.description: Replaces "Frappe" as the product name: the browser tab on the desk, the heading on the login page, and the subject of login emails. Goes to Website Settings → App Name.
fields.label: Product Name

fields.description: Also rewrite the app name shown in the desk sidebar and on the launcher tiles (e.g. "Frappe HR" → your product name). This one is done in the browser, because those labels are rendered client-side from each app's own hooks.
fields.label: Rebrand App Labels In The Desk

fields.description: The mark in the desk navbar, on the /app/desktop launcher and on the login page. Square-ish reads best — it is drawn into a 52px bar. Goes to Website Settings → App Logo and Navbar Settings → App Logo (both, because they feed different screens).
fields.label: Company Logo

fields.description: Browser tab icon. Goes to Website Settings → FavIcon.
fields.label: Favicon

fields.description: Shown while the desk is loading. Wider marks are fine here — it is capped at 200px.
fields.label: Splash Image

fields.description: Replaces "Powered by ERPNext" in the website footer (the job portal, and every other public page). HTML is allowed, so a link works: Powered by <a href="https://cyvetech.com">CyveTech</a>. Goes to Website Settings → Footer "Powered By".
fields.label: Footer "Powered By"
